subject: SIG evidence: access validation, ownership & retention
messages:
From: Kelsey Ramos <kelsey.ramos@medata-health.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medata-health.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — access, ownership, retention

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for agreeing to the SIG follow-up call last week. Our compliance team has started the evidence collection phase and sent over a consolidated list of artifacts they need to validate a handful of control responses. High level asks:

- Ownership matrix for IAM & role onboarding (policy + runbook)
- Proof of session management and console access (screenshots / session diagram)
- Retention policy and retention period for auth logs
- A short index file that maps SIG questions to artifacts (csv or spreadsheet)

Can you confirm who on your side will own each item and whether you can deliver shared Drive links by end of week (Fri 5/22)? If there are items that will need redaction or a non-shared channel (e.g., KMS screenshots), let us know and we can open a secure intake.

Attached is the compliance team's itemized list (referenced as "SIG-Items-0506.pdf").

Best,
Kelsey Ramos
Sr Information Security Analyst
Medata Health

Attachments: SIG-Items-0506.pdf (pdf, 182KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Ramos <kelsey.ramos@medata-health.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — access, ownership, retention

Kelsey — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan below and owners:

- Ownership matrix & policy: Monica Patel will compile the policy PDF and owner table (monica.patel@redwood.ai).
- Runbooks (onboarding, offboarding): Marissa Cole (copied) will produce a runbook index and a redacted runbook where needed.
- Session management / architecture diagram + screenshots: I'll provide an annotated session flow diagram and the console access screenshot; Aditya will review for redaction/KMS notes.
- SIG index mapping (CSV): I'll drop a CSV that maps sig question IDs -> artifact filenames and Drive links.

Timeline: we'll aim to have a Drive folder shared and the index CSV by Thu 5/21 EOD, finalized items by Fri 5/22. If anything needs secure transfer we'll flag it earlier.

Questions: Which retention window does your compliance team prefer for auth logs (30/90/365 days)? We currently retain detailed auth logs for 90 days in the hot store and 1 year in cold archive.

I'll create the Drive folder and share with the security@medata-health.com address and individual contacts once the first artifacts are in.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Ramos <kelsey.ramos@medata-health.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — access, ownership, retention

Thanks — looping in Marissa for runbooks. I pushed a staging Drive folder today with the first-pass artifacts and an index CSV. Links below.

Drive folder (staging, view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD3FghIjKlmNOPqRSTuv
Index file (sig-evidence-index.csv): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1d-IndexLink/view

Currently in the folder: 
- runbook-iam-ownership.pdf (policy + owner table) — owner: Monica Patel
- sig-evidence-index.csv — maps SIG Q IDs to artifacts
- arch-session-diagram.png — high-level session flow diagram (non-sensitive)

Notes:
- Marissa will add redacted onboarding/offboarding runbooks by EOD Thu 5/21.
- We’ve marked any file that contains PII or credentials as "restricted" in the index; those will be provided via a secure transfer (DocuSign bundle / secure S3 link) once we confirm recipient users.

If your team wants a walkthrough, I can schedule a 30-minute session for Thu afternoon.

Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success — Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: runbook-iam-ownership.pdf (policy), sig-evidence-index.csv (csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Ramos <kelsey.ramos@medata-health.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — access, ownership, retention

Quick security notes on the artifacts shared: 

- Console screenshots: attached "access-screenshot-20260519.png" — redacted user IDs and session tokens. Please confirm if you need the unredacted variant for SOC3 scope (we will send over secure channel).
- KMS/Encryption: we do not include KMS key material. I added a short paragraph in runbook-iam-ownership.pdf describing our KMS integration and the HSM-backed key policy.
- Retention: as Logan noted, 90 days hot store / 365 days cold archive. If you need a longer hot retention for your review process we can discuss a temporary extended log export.

Attachment: access-screenshot-20260519.png (png, stub)

Aditya Rao
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Kelsey Ramos <kelsey.ramos@medata-health.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@medata-health.com>, security@medata-health.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — access, ownership & retention

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the staged folder. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- The index CSV is helpful — can you add a column that indicates whether the artifact is "shared" vs "secure-transfer"? That will help our intake triage.
- For the runbook owners: please confirm point-of-contact emails (not aliases) for each runbook row.
- On retention: 90/365 is acceptable for now. If you can provide a one-time export of the last 12 months of auth logs (hashed) into a secure S3 bucket for us to ingest, that would speed validation.

Also — we noted one missing item: a specific step-by-step for emergency role elevation (break-glass) in the onboarding runbook. Can Marissa add that to the redacted runbook?

Thanks,
Kelsey

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Ramos <kelsey.ramos@medata-health.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — access, ownership & retention

Kelsey — good catch. Action items and owners below; I've also added the HubSpot ticket and DocuSign placeholder to track secure transfers.

Action items:
- Add "shared" vs "secure-transfer" column to sig-evidence-index.csv & include point-of-contact emails — owner: Logan Wright — target: Thu 5/21 11:00 PDT.
- Add break-glass step-by-step to onboarding runbook (redacted version) — owner: Marissa Cole — target: Thu 5/21 EOD.
- Prepare 12-month hashed auth log export and place in secure S3 (pre-signed link -> DocuSign/secure transfer) — owner: Aditya Rao — target: Fri 5/22.
- Confirm Drive sharing permissions for security@medata-health.com and Paul Nguyen — owner: Monica Patel — target: Thu 5/21.

Tracking: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/654321 (ticket RDW-1651)
Secure transfer placeholder: DOCUSIGN:987654321

If you'd like a walkthrough, Monica and I can do Thu 5/21 2:00PM PT (30m). Please let us know if that works.

Thanks — we'll follow up as artifacts are updated.

— Logan
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
